Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-in-hiding [[Jax Pavan]] came to the [[Oyu'baat]] seeking information from a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] lieutenant by the name of [[Tyno Fabris]], who was living in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]] at the time. Pavan made several visits to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] establishment during the course of his stay on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] as he attempted to make use of the gangster's resources in locating a [[Thi Xon Yimmon|friend who'd been captured by the Empire]]. During the last of these visits, the Oyu'baat suffered minor damage when a '''firefight''' broke out between Pavan and bodyguards of the recently arrived Black Sun [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], who had gone back on a deal that had been struck between Black Sun and the Jedi. Pavan was forced to flee the cantina through a window, blasting it open with [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] and knocking free a section of the surrounding wall.
